meta.title: Ref completions break when the prefix is a keyword (e.g. `mod`)
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#21999 (fix: Fix ref_match position when keyword prefix)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2026-04-13 and 2026-04-20; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2026-04-20. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: For a reference-match completion ('&mut mod_info') the position of the inserted '&mut ' was computed from an adjusted syntax tree; when the typed prefix is a keyword (mod) the ref text was inserted inside the prefix, giving 'mod&mmod_info'. Reported 2024-11 (0.3.2196), fixed 2026-04.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. Type 'mod' inside the empty argument list of reader.read_to_string() (line 6, character 30), request completion at the end of 'mod' and accept the '&mut mod_info' item. Reported: 'mod&mmod_info'. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the text before the completion did not have.
